title: Checkers
premise: Two players, one board. Jump the other side's pieces, or leave them with nowhere to go.

rules.title: Win by leaving no move
points: Each side starts with {men} pieces. White moves first.
You win when the other side has no pieces, or none that can move.

rules.title: Moving
points: Move a piece one square diagonally onto an empty dark square.
Plain pieces move and jump forward only. Kings go any diagonal way.

rules.title: Capturing
points: Jump a piece next to you, onto the empty square just beyond it.
A capture is compulsory. If you can capture, you must.
Keep jumping with the same piece for as long as you can.

rules.title: Kings
points: A plain piece that reaches the far row becomes a king.
Reaching that row ends your move, even if another jump is open.

rules.title: Ending a game
points: You can resign at any time. The other side wins.
It is a draw if {drawEach} moves each go by with no capture and no plain piece moving.

rules.title: On your phone
points: Tap a piece that is outlined, then tap where it goes.
A jump of several squares is one move: tap where the piece ends up.
